title: Development gap diamond-nine cards
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y9 lesson 17 (Development gap diamond-nine cards (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 17: How did the development gap grow?. To understand the causes of the development gap, including colonialism, trade and debt

cards:
development gap
the difference in development
between richer and poorer countries

colonialism
when one country rules another
and takes its resources

primary products
raw materials like crops and
minerals

trade
buying and selling goods
between countries
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: Explain how debt can slow development.
questions.a: Countries pay interest on loans (1), leaving less money for schools and hospitals (1)
questions.model: Borrow money. Pay it back with interest. Less left for services.

questions.q: Make a causes diamond-nine (nine causes ranked) and, in the portal response box, explain your top two. Starter: 'The most important cause is ... because ...'
questions.a: Justified ranking with links between causes
questions.model: Teacher places two cards and explains.

questions.q: Explain the link between colonialism and trade today.
questions.a: Colonial economies were set up to export raw materials, a pattern that continues

questions.q: Why do many Muslims see interest-based debt as harmful? Link to development.
questions.a: Islam forbids riba; interest debts can trap poor countries in repayments

questions.q: Big question: history, geography or choices?
questions.a: All three, and they are linked; a justified judgement on which matters most
